name: 21-wireguard
teaches: The wireguard block without a privilege: `drt wg keygen` and `drt wg pubkey` are the key pair, so setting up a peer never needs wireguard-tools; `drt wg check` says whether a config can work without touching the interface, including the two cases that otherwise mislead -- an allowed_ips no route will reach, and a block with no peers at all, which is what a rendezvous writes rather than a mistake. 22-wireguard-interface is the half that creates the interface.
